description: This file contains implementation of test hooks and environment statistics provider for Orleans runtime, including a SystemTarget class for testing purposes and a mock environment statistics provider.

classes.name: TestHooksEnvironmentStatisticsProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of IEnvironmentStatisticsProvider for testing, providing controlled environment statistics data.

classes.name: TestHooksSystemTarget
classes.description: A SystemTarget implementation providing test hooks for Orleans, including methods to retrieve silo information, check storage/stream providers, and unregister grains for testing.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentStatistics
methods.description: Returns current environment statistics, fetching real data if current stats are invalid.

methods.name: LatchHardwareStatistics
methods.description: Sets the current environment statistics to the provided data.

methods.name: GetConsistentRingPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Returns the primary target silo address for a given key from the consistent ring provider.

methods.name: GetConsistentRingProviderDiagnosticInfo
methods.description: Returns diagnostic information about the consistent ring provider.

methods.name: GetServiceId
methods.description: Retrieves the service ID from the service provider.

methods.name: HasStorageProvider
methods.description: Checks if a storage provider with the given name exists.

methods.name: HasStreamProvider
methods.description: Checks if a stream provider with the given name exists.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainForTesting
methods.description: Unregisters a grain for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves approximate statuses of silos from the silo status oracle.
